none: PAS NLM-37B2D7: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, possibly a copy, of House of Constantine (306-361), two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate possibly cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---][AVG. Reverse description: two Victories facing each other holding wreaths. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE[ DD AV[GGQ NN]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 13.9mm, Weight: 1.23gms, die axis: 12
